80 PLUS Gold Fully Modular ATX 3.1 Power Supply
80 PLUS® GOLD CERTIFIED
REVOLUTION III 850W power supply is 80 PLUS® Gold certified with efficiency up to 93% on standard loading.
ATX 3.1 READY
REVOLUTION III 850W power supply meets the Intel ATX 3.1 standards to ensure top-notch performance of power hungry graphics cards.
2X Total Power Excursion
3XGPU Power Excursion
100% JAPANESE CAPACITORS
REVOLUTION III 850W power supply incorporates 100% industrial-grade Japanese capacitors with high-quality materials and manufacturing processes, ensuring stable and consistent performance.
FLUID DYNAMIC BEARING FAN
The F.D.B. (Fluid Dynamic Bearing) fan delivers a quiet operation while maintaining the cooling performance.
CERTIFIED FOR OPERATION AT 5000M ALTITUDE AREA
REVOLUTION III 850W power supply is designed with high-quality components and optimized layout for superior insulation and cooling performance. It can continually operate at 40°C and at altitudes up to 5,000 meters, making it suitable for a wide range of environments.
PREMIUM MESH-SLEEVED CABLES
The REVOLUTION III 850W power supply features premium individually mesh-sleeved cables with cable combs for a clean and organized build. The modular sockets, inclined to one side, offer effortless cable routing and management.

Notice:
For users looking to put in a high-end, power-demanding GPU, please plug in the 12+4P / 6P / 6+2P PCIe connector(s) from your ENERMAX power supply to the GPU properly. This will prevent the motherboard from overloading and possibly causing any damage to your system, including your ENERMAX power supply. Once this occurs, it will be treated as improper system configuration, and any damage caused to the power supply, as a result, will not be covered under ENERMAX manufacturer’s warranty. Please refer to your motherboard & GPU’s user manuals to configure your system properly to prevent the motherboard from overloading and causing any damage to your system and your power supply.
The modular cables in the box are all compatible with your newly purchased power supply. Please only use the modular cables provided in your ENERMAX power supply package. Do NOT use other modular cables to prevent pin configuration damage to your system and your power supply.
Info for the rated current of the DC cables: The safety current is 6A per single DC wire. Please note that overloading may cause the connectors or wires meltdown and could void the warranty.
